title: PDAC Nanotherapeutic Architecture: Multiscale Computational Proof of Concept for Nanoparticle Transport and Ferroptosis-Based Therapy in PDAC
description: Version 4.0.0 research software integrating nanoparticle diffusion, heterogeneous stromal transport, transport-to-ferroptosis coupling, deterministic/stochastic dynamics, LHS-PRCC, computed Sobol sensitivity, constrained in-silico dosing optimization, calibration utilities, and a documented pathway for external human-data validation. This is a Project Proposal / Computational Proof of Concept and not a clinical decision tool or validated therapy.
notes: No individual-level human data are redistributed. Human repositories are documented as sources for future calibration and external validation.
